name: Shuffled 707 skitter
desc: Moodier sibling of the RZ-1 skitter: a RolandTR707 kick/rim cell iter-rotating over four bars, triplet-shuffle CasioRZ1 hats (elongation swing, no banned .swing), dub delay in the sparse skeleton, and a tom euclid surfacing at peak. Half-lit, woozy, head-nodding braindance.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [rim ~ bd] ~ rim ~ bd rim").bank("RolandTR707").iter(4).gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(saw.range(.12,.32).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.5).room(${room})).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(32)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[bd bd] rim [~ bd] rim bd rim [bd bd] rim").bank("RolandTR707").iter(4).gain(${gain}).shape(.28), s("[hh@2 hh]*8").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(saw.range(.15,.38).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("~ [cp,sd] ~ [cp,sd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.55).room(${room}), s("mt(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.35)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).every(8, rev).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
